title: Norwegian Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender pork and a blend of Norwegian spices.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the beef broth and red wine (if using), whisking constantly.
Return the pork to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2-3 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Stir in the apple cider vinegar and dried thyme.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley (optional).
